summary: Tested admin JWT auth (login/me), protection of admin endpoints, frontend login gate + session + logout + orders/abandoned tabs, Footer 'Shop' column removal, and public-site regression. 16/17 backend pytest cases pass. 1 backend bug: /api/admin/abandoned-carts is UNPROTECTED (returns 200 with no token). All frontend flows on preview URL work: login gate shows admin-login when logged out, wrong password shows admin-login-error 'Invalid email or password', correct creds (admin@oblic.com / Oblic@Admin2026) show admin-page with 15 orders in orders-table and 4 stat cards; token persisted in localStorage.oblic_admin_token (~159 chars); reload keeps session; changing order-status-{n} dropdown persists (backend PATCH ok); admin-tab-abandoned renders abandoned-table; admin-logout clears token and returns to admin-login. Footer has only 'Category' and 'Company' columns (no 'Shop' column); newsletter, whatsapp, address links intact. Shop page still shows 3 products publicly. No runtime console errors.

critical.issue: Endpoint is NOT protected with Depends(require_admin) — returns 200 with no Bearer token. Anyone can list all abandoned-cart emails/items. Add `admin=Depends(require_admin)` to the handler (server.py line ~397).

action_items: Add `admin=Depends(require_admin)` to admin_abandoned_carts handler in /app/backend/server.py so /api/admin/abandoned-carts returns 401 without a valid Bearer token.
critical_code_review_comments: One admin endpoint missed the auth dependency — verify by grepping `@api_router.get("/admin` for any handler without `Depends(require_admin)`.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env; acceptable for preview, but rotate before prod.
seed_admin only re-hashes when password differs; if only email changes, old admin remains. Consider deleting stale admins or seeding by unique key.
server.py at ~465 lines is still manageable; consider splitting when auth/admin/payments grow.
CORS is `*` with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard, harmless for Bearer flow but worth tightening for prod.
seed_data_creation: Public test order created via POST /api/orders (TEST_admin@example.com, TEST_pub@example.com) for PATCH verification. Harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py cover login, me, protection of /admin/orders, /admin/stats, /admin/abandoned-carts, PATCH /admin/orders/{id}, and public regression. After main agent adds require_admin to /api/admin/abandoned-carts, re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py -v. All 17 should pass.
